Check the source, requirements, missing skills and any mandatory exclusions.", }, { title: "4. Redirects and browser messages cannot unlock access.", }, ], }, faq: { label: "FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS", title: "A few things you might be wondering.", intro: "Straight answers about what works today and what needs setup.", sections: [ { title: "Are the demo jobs real?", text: "No. The demo uses clearly marked fictional companies and example opportunities. Your account supports manual imports. Live feeds require approved source access.", }, { title: "Does a match score guarantee an interview?", text: "No. The explained fit estimate weighs evidence from your selected resume, skills, role and experience. Mandatory preferences apply first. It cannot predict selection or every ATS system.", }, { title: "Will this automatically apply for jobs?", text: "No. Application submissions stay under your control. Opening a job link does not change its application status.", }, { title: "Can I upload a private resume?", text: "Resumes are private. PDF and DOCX processing works only with configured private storage, malware scanning and isolated extraction. Until that setup is complete, use the text editor. The interface shows the actual connection status.", }, { title: "Can I receive daily WhatsApp alerts?", text: "The settings are ready for consent and schedule preferences, but dispatch remains disabled until your destination is verified, consent is confirmed and the official provider connection and approved template are configured.", }, { title: "Is this ready for a broad launch?", text: "This is a private working review build. The handover documents record missing integrations, security verification and production release requirements. It is not certified or claimed to be fully secure.", }, ], }, contact: { label: "CONTACT & SUPPORT", title: "A little help for your next step.", intro: "Support channels are being configured for the private review build.", sections: [ { title: "Product support", text: "Contact the Site owner through the existing project conversation. A monitored support address has not yet been configured; this page does not submit or send a message.", }, { title: "Security contact", text: "Report security concerns privately to the Site owner. A monitored security mailbox and incident alerts must be established before public launch. Do not share passwords or private resume content in a report.", }, { title: "Integration enquiries", text: "Job providers, document processors and notification services must have approved access and suitable data-processing terms before connection.", }, ], }, privacy: { label: "PRIVACY", title: "Your professional story belongs to you.", intro: "This is a build-specific privacy summary, not a completed legal policy. Launch-region obligations and provider contracts require review.", sections: [ { title: "What the working build stores", text: "Your signed-in identity, confirmed profile, preferences, resume versions, job records, applications, private practice sessions and alert settings are stored in the Site database. Agent settings, confirmed and inferred facts, answers, saved searches, workflow history, application snapshots and protected action manifests are also private records. Configured uploads use private document storage. The public demo runs in memory and resets when you leave.", }, { title: "Access and sharing", text: "Account operations check the current identity and record ownership on the server. Profile sharing and document public links are disabled. Contact information is not published.", }, { title: "External processing", text: "External AI, document processing, employer feeds, email and WhatsApp operate only when explicitly configured. They receive only the information needed for the requested purpose. Deployment-specific provider disclosures, retention and contracts must be reviewed before sensitive data collection. Payments remain disabled.", }, { title: "Your controls", text: "Use Settings to export your records. Online account deletion is disabled until recent sign-in can be verified. Proposed backup retention and deletion timelines must be configured and tested before launch; deletion from live tables does not promise immediate deletion from backups.", }, ], }, terms: { label: "TERMS", title: "Clear expectations for a career workspace.", intro: "These preliminary product terms need legal review before a commercial public launch.", sections: [ { title: "Use responsibly", text: "Use your own information and job descriptions you are authorized to use. Review facts in every resume and application. Do not upload or import instructions intended to misuse the service.", }, { title: "Career guidance", text: "Matching is an explained heuristic, not a guarantee of employment, ATS acceptance or interview selection. Practice tools do not infer personality, honesty or employability.", }, { title: "Current scope", text: "This private build has no paid plans. Configurable services show their actual connection status. The demonstration is fictional, and self-review is distinguished from external AI.", }, ], }, security: { label: "SECURITY", title: "Protection built into the foundations.", intro: "Targeting applicable OWASP ASVS 5.0 Level 2 controls. Coverage is partial and requires further testing; this is not a certification.", sections: [ { title: "Server-side boundaries", text: "Authenticated ownership is checked for data reads and writes. Mutations require same-origin checks, a custom action header, validated bodies and bounded request sizes. Private responses are not cached.", }, { title: "Sensitive features fail closed", text: "Private document processing requires a trusted scanner and isolated worker. AI and notification actions require explicit configuration, authorization and usage controls. Sharing, payment access and administrative actions remain unavailable unless their additional security requirements are met.", }, { title: "Hosting identity", text: "Sign-in and sessions are managed by Sites. Independent email/password registration, recovery and administrator MFA attestation are not implemented here. The Worker must be reachable only through trusted dispatch.", }, { title: "Ongoing verification", text: "The handover includes control mappings, threat analysis, actual test evidence, launch blockers and operational procedures. Independent review, restoration drills and provider end-to-end testing remain necessary.", }, ], }, }; export function PublicPage({ slug }: { slug: string }) { const data = publicPages[slug]; return (
